api_key.description: Optional API key — free tier works without it. A free-tier caller gets reckon_mission_graph, reckon_dashboard, reckon_coc, reckon_sign, reckon_pubkey, reckon_corpus, reckon_vocab, reckon_charter, and reckon_manifest. A paid key lifts rate limits and unlocks pro-tier tools (reckon_pdf raw extract/ocr/merge/split, reckon_chat, reckon_eval_metrics, reckon_evolve).
